create_transformed_distribution: create a Transformed distribution by applying a bijector to a base distribution like Normal
compute_log_prob_transformed: compute the log probability of a value under a Transformed distribution using inverse and log det jacobian
sample_and_log_prob_transformed: sample from a Transformed distribution and get log probabilities efficiently using only the forward bijector
calculate_mean_transformed: calculate the mean of a Transformed distribution when its bijector has a constant Jacobian
calculate_entropy_transformed: calculate the Shannon entropy of a Transformed distribution when its bijector has a constant log determinant
